Code.Name: Passenger, normal service (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled passenger flight. Cargo is carried in the hold below the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger, shuttle mode (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled passenger flight in shuttle mode. Cargo is carried in the hold below the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger, normal service (additional flight)
Code.Description: Passenger flight outside the published schedule. Cargo is carried in the hold below the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger, shuttle mode (additional flight)
Code.Description: Passenger flight in shuttle mode outside the published schedule. Cargo is carried in the hold below the cabin.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo in cabin (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled flight on an aircraft in mixed configuration. Cargo is carried in the cabin as well as in the hold.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo in cabin (additional flight)
Code.Description: Flight on an aircraft in mixed configuration outside the published schedule. Cargo is carried in the cabin as well as in the hold.

Code.Name: Passenger and cargo and/or mail (charter)
Code.Description: Charter flight carrying passengers together with cargo.

Code.Name: Cargo, loose loaded and/or preloaded devices (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled freighter. The aircraft carries cargo only, on the main deck and in the hold.

Code.Name: Cargo and/or mail (additional flight)
Code.Description: Freighter outside the published schedule. The aircraft carries cargo only.

Code.Name: Cargo and/or mail (charter)
Code.Description: Charter freighter. The aircraft carries cargo only.

Code.Name: Cargo, operated by surface vehicle (scheduled)
Code.Description: Scheduled cargo service carried by a surface vehicle under a flight number, a road feeder service replacing a leg of the air carriage.
